number_of_accused.quote: the defendant is the distributor of films

accused_gender.reason: The accused is referred to as 'her'.

accused_occupation.quote: the defendant is the distributor of films
accused_occupation.reason: The complainant's case describes her as a film distributor.

victim_gender.quote: he is the owner of the Ullas Theatre

accused_victim_relationship.quote: The two parties had a business relationship
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Business relationship between the film distributor and the theatre owner.

offence_category.quote: a complaint under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 was filed
offence_category.reason: The case concerns cheque dishonour, not narcotics.

statutory_provisions.reason: Sections 138 and 139 are the provisions applied.

evidence_type.correct_value: Documentary (cheque, bank memo, notice) and oral testimony, with the statutory presumption under s.139
evidence_type.quote: the cheque as well as the signature has been accepted by the accused
evidence_type.reason: Mainly documentary and presumption-based. The 'circumstantial' label is only loosely supported.

confession.reason: No confession; the accused admitted only the cheque and signature.

trial_court_outcome.quote: found the defendant guilty and sentenced her to pay Rs. 5, 55, 000/-
trial_court_outcome.reason: Matches the trial court's conviction and sentence.

high_court_outcome.quote: set aside the judgments of the two Courts below and acquitted the respondent

final_outcome.reason: The Supreme Court restored the conviction.

offence_finally_established.quote: convicting the respondent for an offence under Section 138

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Fine only; simple imprisonment only in default of payment
imprisonment_type.quote: sentencing her to pay a fine of Rs.5,55,000/-, in default to suffer Simple Imprisonment for five months
imprisonment_type.reason: The primary sentence is a fine; imprisonment arises only in default.

imprisonment_years.correct_value: About 0.42 years (five months), only in default of fine
imprisonment_years.quote: in default to suffer Simple Imprisonment for five months
imprisonment_years.reason: It is five months, not five years, and only in default.

neutral_facts.correct_value: As the complainant alleged, the accused borrowed Rs.5 lakh; she denied taking any loan and said the cheque dated from 1999.
neutral_facts.quote: She has disputed taking any loan from the complainant as claimed by him.
neutral_facts.reason: The loan and non-repayment are stated as fact although the accused disputed them. Otherwise it is broadly accurate and does not reveal the outcome.

offence_severity.correct_value: Fine of Rs.5,55,000, with five months' simple imprisonment only in default
offence_severity.quote: in default to suffer Simple Imprisonment for five months
offence_severity.reason: Imprisonment is not an alternative to the fine; it applies only on default.

attempt_completion.reason: The offence was complete: the cheque was dishonoured and notice went unpaid.

financial_property_loss.quote: The cheque was for Rs.5 lakhs only
financial_property_loss.reason: The loss is the Rs.5 lakh loan; Rs.5,55,000 is the fine.

motive.reason: No motive is attributed to the accused.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: since the cheque as well as the signature has been accepted by the accused respondent
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Matches the court's reasoning, including the stop-payment inference.

witness_credibility.quote: the story brought out by the accused is unworthy of credit, apart from being unsupported by any evidence

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused stopped payment of the cheque and did not pay or respond to the legal notice
post_offence_conduct.quote: the defendant neither made the payment nor responded to the same
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment does describe post-offence conduct.

trial_duration.correct_value: Loan 20-05-2006; cheque 16-01-2007; appellate (Fast Track Court) judgment 22-01-2011; High Court 22-07-2011; Supreme Court 28-04-2015
trial_duration.quote: the judgment dated 22. 01.2011, delivered by the Presiding Officer, Fast Track Court-I
trial_duration.reason: 22-01-2011 is the first appellate judgment, not the trial judgment. The trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.quote: Rajesh Mahale, Krutin R. Joshi, for the Appellant

investigation_status.correct_value: Private complaint under s.138 before the Magistrate; trial completed; no charge sheet mentioned
investigation_status.quote: a complaint under Section 138 ... was filed by the complainant before the XII Magistrate
investigation_status.reason: This was a private complaint; no charge sheet is mentioned.

appeal_history.quote: The High Court in appeal reversed the concurrent finding
appeal_history.reason: The sequence is correct (the Fast Track Court dismissed the appeal in between).

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Loan of Rs.5 lakh advanced on 20-05-2006 was not repaid; the accused gave a cheque on 16-01-2007 in repayment, which was dishonoured (stop payment) and the notice went unanswered.
prosecution_argument.quote: the defendant on 16-01-2007, gave a cheque for Rs.5 lakhs
prosecution_argument.reason: The cheque was given for repayment of the loan, not as security.

defence_argument.quote: the alleged cheque was given to the complainant in the year 1999 as security against loan of Rs.5 lakhs

legal_principle_applied.quote: the presumption under Section 139 would operate

sentencing_rationale.quote: the burden of proof had shifted on the accused which the accused failed to discharge
sentencing_rationale.reason: Conviction and sentence restored because the presumption was not rebutted.

other_sentence_order.quote: sentencing her to pay a fine of Rs.5,55,000/-, in default to suffer Simple Imprisonment for five months
